scope: Start the paid primary collection of the frozen 120-case evaluation on October's remaining OpenRouter monthly headroom under the unchanged $2 cutoff.
partial_run_policy: A partial run is accepted as unusable; do not resume it or present it as a complete evaluation.
preserved_safety: Keep the monthly Redis ledger read-only and never initialize, reset, lower, delete, or reconcile its keys.
Verify the exact environment before the cohort and recheck current key usage and endpoint-wide conservative prices before every provider request.
Count and durably journal every provider request; retain unknown charges and stop on any financial uncertainty.
Never exceed the unchanged $2 monthly cutoff.
Do not resume a failed or partial run.
Do not change the frozen contract, cohort, serving code, production settings, aliases, or deployment state.
